messages.text: Velkommen Agnes, welcome to NetHack!  You are a neutral human Valkyrie.
There is a staircase down here.

inventory.text: a blessed +1 spear (weapon in right hand)

underfoot.look: a staircase down or a ladder down or a branch staircase down or a branch ladder down (staircase down)

lines: There is a staircase down here.
Agnes the Stripling           St:18 Dx:13 Co:18 In:7 Wi:9 Ch:8 Neutral

notes: First Sokoban level (entered from below); the hero stands on the down staircase; the up staircase is 2 squares north. Boulders lie to the west and east, pits to the north-east, a line of pits/holes further north. The level may be mirrored in 5.0.
